name: dax_divide_with_an_alternate_result
expect_sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(t.units_received), 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(t.units_sold) / SUM(t.units_received) END AS sell_through,
       (CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(RTRIM(t.region)) = 'SOUTH' THEN t.units_received END), 0) = 0 THEN -1 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(RTRIM(t.region)) = 'SOUTH' THEN t.units_sold END) / SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(RTRIM(t.region)) = 'SOUTH' THEN t.units_received END) END) AS south_sell_through
FROM   retail.fct_sales t
